title: Build Hour: GPT-Realtime-2
description:
Build with the next wave of realtime voice AI. In this Build Hour, you’ll learn how to use GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper to build low-latency voice agents that can translate live speech, reason across tools, operate apps, and support more natural voice-to-voice and voice-to-action experiences.

In this session, Teri Yu (Product) and Erika Kettleson (Solutions Engineering) will cover:
• Building with new realtime audio models for translation, streaming speech-to-text, and intelligent voice agents
• Using GPT-Realtime-2 capabilities like preambles, 128K context, parallel tool calling, domain understanding, context over turns, and controllable expressiveness
• Creating voice-powered workflows for shopping and product analytics dashboards
• Customer Spotlight on how Sierra (https://sierra.ai/) is designing production customer experience agents with guardrails, VAD tuning, tracing, redaction, evals, and customer-specific harnesses.

segments.heading: Core Architecture and Technical Motivations for Build Hour: GPT-Realtime-2
segments.text: In this session on Build Hour: GPT-Realtime-2, Sarah Urbonus, OpenAI Realtime Team examine the underlying architectural principles and operational requirements shaping frontier AI systems. The presentation highlights how modern engineering teams leverage OpenAI, GPT-Realtime-2, WebSockets to address foundational challenges in LLM Fundamentals, Web Development. Rather than relying on rigid heuristic pipelines, the architecture emphasizes end-to-end model legibility, structured context windows, and robust feedback loops. Participants explore how these patterns eliminate brittle manual glue code, providing a resilient platform capable of maintaining accuracy even under intense compute constraints and rapid requirement iteration.

segments.heading: Implementation Mechanics, System Workflows, and Tool Integrations
segments.text: Diving into technical mechanics, the speakers demonstrate concrete implementation workflows using OpenAI, GPT-Realtime-2, WebSockets. Key engineering workflows center on deterministic execution pipelines, rigorous schema validation, and low-latency data flow. By decomposing complex objectives into auditable intermediate states, developers can reliably track token expenditures, isolate runtime anomalies, and enforce strict execution boundaries. The session walks through hands-on architectures where automated orchestration safely manages high-concurrency requests, external API calls, and persistent state stores.

segments.heading: Operational Deployment, Evaluation Benchmarks, and Future Trajectory
segments.text: The concluding segment addresses enterprise deployment standards, cost efficiency trade-offs, and empirical evaluation benchmarks. Speakers present metrics for assessing reliability in production environments, emphasizing continuous evaluation against realistic task distributions. Organizations deploying OpenAI, GPT-Realtime-2, WebSockets must balance inference latency with reasoning depth, ensuring that guardrails and safety invariants remain intact throughout system lifecycle. Looking ahead, the discussion outlines upcoming platform milestones and strategic paradigms for scaling autonomous, high-integrity AI workloads across diverse industry domains.
